_comment: Copy this file to the SERVER'S DATA DIRECTORY as version.json to enable update notices. The server re-reads it on every /version request, so edits take effect immediately - no restart. 'latest' must be major.minor.patch; 'url' is where the Get-it button sends people (your GitHub Releases page); 'notes' is an optional one-liner shown in the banner.
notes: Schedules: put a class on the calendar once and see the whole term ahead. Also: three blocks per slot, archive a whole folder, drag to reorder. IMPORTANT - update, then delete any older TickTimer you still have installed: an old build can silently strip a newer planner.
